description: [Ncloud Storage] Copy a byte range of an existing object into a part of a multipart upload (PUT /{key}?partNumber&uploadId with x-amz-copy-source). Use it to assemble or re-class objects larger than the 5 GB CopyObject limit without downloading them.

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

copySource.description: Source object as {sourceBucket}/{sourceKey} (a leading slash is tolerated)

copySourceRange.description: Byte range to copy from the source, e.g. 'bytes=0-5242879'. Omit to copy the whole source object as this part

copySourceVersionId.description: Version ID of the source object (versioning-enabled buckets)

key.description: Object key (path) of the multipart upload target

name: ncloud_ncs_upload_part_copy
